finalists.label: Basal Cell Carcinoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a small, pearly lesion and a biopsy showing nodular BCC.

finalists.label: Eyelid Malignancy
finalists.why: It is supported by findings of a lesion on the left lower eyelid and is a broader category that could encompass the patient's condition.

finalists.label: Cicatricial Ectropion
finalists.why: It explains the contraction of the conjunctival mucosal tissue and cicatricial effects causing conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive findings, including a biopsy showing nodular BCC, which directly supports the diagnosis of Basal Cell Carcinoma.
